defaults.name: routine gets one nudge — a missed vitamin is not an event
critical gets five — the case the feature exists for
unknown priority falls to routine, matching priorityMeta
priority is matched case-insensitively — the column is free text

custom.name: a critical med may be asked every 3 minutes, ten times — exactly at the cap
one rung at 30 is allowed — the cap is on the product, not the interval
a partial config takes the priority default for the missing half
over the cap is IGNORED, not clamped — fall back to the known-good default
zero rungs is not a way to silence a medication
a fractional interval falls back rather than firing at odd seconds

validation.name: exactly at the cap is valid
product over the cap is not

_cancellationComment: `expectedCancelled` is the set of rungs that had NOT yet fired when the dose
was answered — i.e. exactly the alarms to cancel. It is not the set that
rings; resolving means none of them ring.

cancellation.name: answered before any rung fired — all five are cancelled, none ring
answered mid-ladder — the two that fired stand, the three ahead are cancelled
answered exactly on a rung — that one has already fired, so it is not cancelled
answered after the ladder finished — the sticky is up and there is nothing to cancel
a one-rung routine ladder answered late
